import pytest

from plugbox.builtin import Reverse, Upper
from plugbox.registry import Registry


def make() -> Registry:
    reg = Registry()
    reg.register("upper", Upper)
    reg.register("reverse", Reverse)
    return reg


def test_names_keep_order():
    assert make().names() == ["upper", "reverse"]


def test_duplicate_name():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        make().register("upper", Upper)


def test_get_and_create():
    reg = make()
    assert reg.get("upper") is Upper
    assert reg.create("reverse").run("abc") == "cba"
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        reg.get("missing")


def test_unregister():
    reg = make()
    reg.unregister("upper")
    assert reg.names() == ["reverse"]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        reg.unregister("upper")

"""Load plugin factories from "module:attribute" specs."""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
from typing import Any

from plugbox.registry import Registry


def load_factory(spec: str) -> Any:
    """Import "package.module:attr" and return the attribute."""
    module_name, _, attr = spec.partition(":")
    if not attr:
        raise ValueError(f"spec {spec!r} needs a ':attribute' part")
    return getattr(importlib.import_module(module_name), attr)


def register_all(registry: Registry, specs: dict[str, str]) -> None:
    """Register each name to the factory its spec points at."""
    for name, spec in specs.items():
        registry.register(name, load_factory(spec))
